title: CDC PLACES 2025 county-level model-based obesity prevalence (2023 measure)
limitations: CDC PLACES reports small-area MODEL-BASED estimates, not directly observed county surveys.
2025 release obesity prevalence is modeled using the 2023 BRFSS input period; it is not a 2025 outcome measurement.
Confidence intervals are model-produced estimates; not claims of measured intervention effectiveness.
CDC explicitly cautions against using PLACES for impact evaluation of local interventions.
Coverage is 3,143 2025-source county records across 50 states and DC; Puerto Rico is excluded.
Data access and usage rights are independently reviewed before promoting a staged release.
